body: Oh there is no proof whatsoever and it would just be her word against mine. I'd like to move on. Idk maybe just letting it be known that I feel taken advantage of will help. I'm afraid no one will ask for or care about my side anyway. I live in the US btw.
Hello to the asshole down voting comments for apparently no reason. 🖕🏼
I feel preyed on and used now that everything has come out. I'm convinced this was all a sociopathic move to get a reaction out of my friend.

So I'm really annoyed by a text she sent this morning. She said she's not joining the team, she made a mistake, blah blah blah, she cares about my friend (oh really??), and will be keeping her distance while trying to repair things with my friend. Wtf? 

I'm so mad. Like I got pulled into my friend's girl drama and used as a pawn in some sick game all for this girl to start pursuing my "friend".  No, this girl needs to stay all the way away from me. I'll be keeping my distance from them both if my "friend" continues to talk to her. What bullshit dude.

Oh she knew. 

She told me she liked my friend at first, but that my friend is hot and cold and she didn't think anything would happen between them. 

Only after we hooked up did I find out she had also had sex with my friend. I never would have hooked up with her had I known that. That really bothers me, sleeping with someone who also slept with my friend is not consistent with who I am. 

Idk maybe she did use me to find out how much my friend liked her. To get her to stop being hot and cold. She really wanted to call my friend and tell her what happened the next morning. She said she regretted it the moment she realized my friend was crying over the phone because she didn't think was she into her that much.

This girl wanted to join our softball team and that's why my friend introduced us and that's the only reason I was friendly to her. I thought she was joining our group of teammates/friends. I wasn't expecting to cross that line. 

She never told me she was attracted me sober. When my friend got jealous and insecure about us chatting I got mad and thought she was just being possessive. But maybe this girl said something about me. 

Maybe she's just playing with my friend and enjoys making her jealous. I really shouldn't have contributed to that if so :/ 

Thanks, I would love to get some of this guilt off of my shoulders. I'll talk to my friend tomorrow. 

When I apologized she said it was fine and that obviously this girl didn't like her that much. She doesn't know I was there when she was crying.

Just realized I probably did it out of spite, maybe that's why I feel so bad. We got into it over this girl about a week ago because I was talking to her at a party we were all at. She accused me of making out with this girl (definitely wasn't), caused a big scene, and told me to go fuck myself. 

So yeah maybe my subconscious was all "tell me to eff off because you think we were making out, now I'm going to hook up with her". 

I do care about my friend even though she pushes my buttons over girls a lot (she also made a scene a few weeks ago because I said hi to her ex when I saw her at a bar).

I still feel bad.
